faq.question: What is Peaks?
faq.answer: Peaks is the member-portal flow that finds high-signal moments on YouTube (Most Replayed), Twitch (chat peaks), and Kick (live CCV), then stages a trim into the Short production pipeline.

faq.question: What's included in the AuraFlux plan?
faq.answer: One plan covers the member portal, Peaks (Most Replayed, chat spikes, CCV), the Short production pipeline, and publish to connected accounts. Inquire about Managed if you want done-for-you production.

faq.question: How do credits work?
faq.answer: The plan includes 400 credits per month. Buy packs inside the app if you need more mid-cycle. Managed credit capacity is scoped when you inquire.

faq.question: Which platforms can I publish to?
faq.answer: Connect social accounts in the app and publish from the job. YouTube and TikTok are primary paths today, with more platforms available through your connected accounts.
